Tripura Tourism calls Unakoti a Shaiva pilgrimage with rock carvings dated to the 7th to 9th centuries, including a Shiva head about 30 feet high.
The state page says the Ashokastami Mela at Unakoti draws thousands of pilgrims each April.
The tourism page puts Unakoti 178 km from Agartala and 8 km from Kailashahar, reached via Kumarghat.
The state page calls Kailashahar the headquarters of North Tripura. The catalog fact already says Unakoti district, and that placement is kept.
